is 10% niacinamide better than 5%?

Most niacinamide studies used 2 to 5%. In one trial, 50 women used 5% twice a day for 12 weeks, and spots, fine lines and redness improved.

We couldn't find a study showing 10% or 20% works better than 5%. Higher strengths sting more for some people, and irritation can lead to more dark marks.

So if your 10% bottle burns, dropping to 5% isn't a downgrade.

Send this to the friend buying the strongest bottle.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Sources:
Bissett et al., Dermatol Surg 2005
Ong et al., Drug Deliv Transl Res 2024 (review)
